description_en: Generates images based on a provided text description and returns a task ID
description_zh: 根据提供的文字描述生成图片，并返回任务ID
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-image-task --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --prompt '一间全是猫的会议室' --negative-prompt '低质量,模糊,变形' --model qwen-image-2.0-pro --size 102401024 --n 1 --seed 42 --prompt-extend true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageTask

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The image description (positive prompt), up to 800 characters
parameters.help_zh: 图片描述文字（正向提示词），不超过 800 字符
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The negative prompt, up to 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 反向提示词，不超过 500 字符
parameters.name: negative_prompt

parameters.help_en: The image size (format: width×height). Default value: `2048*2048`
parameters.help_zh: 图片尺寸（格式 宽高），默认 `20482048`
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The number of images to generate (1 to 6). Default value: `1`
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The random seed (0 to 2147483647). A value of 0 indicates random
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent prompt rewriting. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启提示词智能改写，默认true
parameters.name: prompt_extend

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value `OK` is returned if the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned if the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned if the request was successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. Use this ID to call the GetImageTaskResult operation to query the results
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，用于调用 `GetImageTaskResult` 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
TaskId.title_zh: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
